source.product: ERA5 monthly averaged data on single levels from 1940 to present
source.citation: Hersbach, H., Bell, B., Berrisford, P., Biavati, G., Horányi, A., Muñoz Sabater, J., Nicolas, J., Peubey, C., Radu, R., Rozum, I., Schepers, D., Simmons, A., Soci, C., Dee, D., Thépaut, J-N. (2023): ERA5 monthly averaged data on single levels from 1940 to present. Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store (CDS), DOI: 10.24381/cds.f17050d7 (Accessed on 11-Oct-2026).

operation: Select ERA5 GRIB fields with shortName=2t for 2019-01 through 2019-12 and serialize as NetCDF. No resampling, coordinate reordering, reprojection, or unit conversion.

output.grid: Regular latitude/longitude, 0.25 degree, 721 x 1440; source coordinate order preserved

validation: Readback comparison verified 12 monthly fields, values, coordinates, and missing-value counts against the selected source fields.
license_and_attribution: CC BY 4.0 under applicable CDS terms. Cite DOI 10.24381/cds.f17050d7 and use the Copernicus attribution/disclaimer shown in the product record.
limitations: This is a single-variable processed subset, not the original nine-variable GRIB.
It has not been matched to any aerosol pH model or other scientific input.
